// A triple bracketing a minimum: Lower < Middle < Upper with the function
// value at Middle below the value at both ends.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden-section_search)
type BracketedMinimum
    implements IValue
{
    Lower: Number;
    Middle: Number;
    Upper: Number;
}
